2 Profile description

Hi, I'm Al Amin — a freelance digital specialist from Bangladesh and a former Bangladesh Army serviceman (2022–2025). I help businesses and creators with six things: multilingual customer support in English, Hindi and Bangla (live chat & email, using Jira, Slack and Chatwoot), video editing in Adobe Premiere Pro, responsive web development with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, app creation & development, media buying across Facebook, Google and YouTube (GA4, Pixel & Conversion API tracking, budget management and optimisation), and graphic design in Photoshop and Illustrator. My promise is simple: honest communication, on-time delivery and work I'd be proud to put my name on. Message me and let's build something great.
